record.title: UNWomen ACT Project End of Project Evaluation
record.opportunity_summary: 30-day remote end-of-project evaluation of the UN Women ACT project across Eastern and Southern Africa, covering October 2024-November 2026. Evaluation addresses results framework and Theory of Change, relevance, coherence, effectiveness, efficiency, impact, sustainability, advocacy, coalition-building and feminist movement strengthening. Mixed methods, participatory and feminist/intersectional approaches are expected.
record.fit_summary: Strong research/MEL and regional-development fit, but mandatory senior gender/EVAWG/feminist-evaluation credentials are not established for Tuku-Tuku or Jacob and must be supplied by a compliant lead specialist/team member.
record.decision_rationale: Worth pursuing only if a compliant senior feminist evaluation/EVAWG lead can be secured quickly. The research/evaluation architecture and knowledge-product requirements fit Tuku-Tuku, but the specialist qualification gate is material.
mandatory_requirements: Relevant professional qualifications and current membership in a recognised professional body
At least 10 years progressive experience in gender equality, women's rights and EVAWG
Proven evaluations, assessments or research experience
EU- and/or UN Women-funded project evaluation experience
Strong understanding of Pan-African feminist principles and EVAWG frameworks
Technical plus financial proposal not more than 5 pages
CV/CVs not more than 3 pages including three professional referees
One sample work from relevant assignments; applications without sample work are not assessed
gaps: No verified 10-year EVAWG/gender-equality lead credential currently established
No verified EU/UN Women evaluation reference currently established
No verified feminist-evaluation sample work currently established
Professional-body membership requirement must be checked against proposed lead
hard_blockers: Secure compliant senior EVAWG/feminist evaluation lead
Confirm three professional referees in proposed lead CV
deliverables: Remote stakeholder consultations and validation outputs
application_requirements: Technical methodology and financial proposal <=5 pages
record.winning_strategy: Recruit a senior feminist evaluator/EVAWG lead who independently clears the 10-year, Master's, professional-membership and EU/UN Women evaluation gates; position Tuku-Tuku around mixed-methods evaluation operations, programme learning, data workflows and knowledge-product production. Do not attribute unverified gender/EVAWG credentials to Tuku or Jacob.
record.source_context: Original FEMNET career/procurement page checked 18 Sep 2026.
record.next_action: By 19 Sep, score the available and incoming MEAL CVs against the EVAWG/feminist-evaluation gates; if neither clears them, recruit a compliant senior lead immediately.
